steps.prompt: The rook moves any number of squares in a straight line: along a rank or along a file. It cannot jump over pieces.
steps.explanation: The rook moves any number of squares in a straight line: along a rank or along a file. It cannot jump over pieces.

steps.prompt: Tap any square the white rook on d4 can move to.
steps.explanation: The rook slides along the d-file and the 4th rank until it meets a piece. It may stop on an enemy piece to capture it.

steps.prompt: Capture the black pawn on g4 with your rook.
steps.explanation: To capture, move onto the enemy piece's square. The captured piece leaves the board.
Rooks go straight only. Diagonals belong to bishops.
steps.hint: Think of the rook's tower shape: straight lines.

steps.prompt: Give check by moving the rook to the 8th rank.
steps.explanation: From a8 the rook attacks along the whole 8th rank, so the black king on e8 is in check.
